# SCI-FRUIT: proposed return to the scientific core

Date: 2026-09-06. Status: owner-review scope proposal; not a contract or author packet.

Decision candidate: `SCI-FRUIT-SCIENTIFIC-CORE-SCOPE-R0.1`.

## Program adherence and prior-work recovery

This proposal follows the [charter](../../../../README.md),
[pilot process review](../../../../PILOT_PROCESS_REVIEW_2026-08-16.md),
[downstream roadmap](../../../../DOWNSTREAM_CONTRACT_ROADMAP_2026-08-26.md),
[package prior work](../PRIOR_WORK.md) and completed
[bounded evidence review](BOUNDED_EVIDENCE_REVIEW_R0.1.md).
It proposes a scope change for the existing package, not a fresh derivation
of PTC, mapmaking or the already accepted comparison framework.

Adopt the frozen adjacent-package ownership and existing scientific identity
conventions. Cite empirical history only to explain the manager's proposed
scope. Defer every unavailable numerical method and performance claim. The
genuinely new work would be the limited scientific closure of feedback-model,
transition, conditional response and termination semantics after explicit
owner choices. An author would receive only the approved successor scope,
decisions, conventions and exact frozen-authority extracts; no source code,
empirical results or this implementation-informed review packet is admitted.

## Recommended direction

Conclude the present benefit-selector exploration with no qualifying
replacement and prepare a scientific-core contract for iterative sky-model
feedback. Treat the historical complete-product recurrence as the required
empirical control and a compatibility candidate. Do not automatically adopt
its thresholds, detector decisions or numerical behavior as scientific truth.

The contract would explain what a declared feedback method means, what it
must supply, how its response and causal state compose, and when a claim is
unavailable. A concrete numerical profile would need its own complete bindings
and evidence. A framework contract with unavailable numerical profiles is a
deliberately limited deliverable; it would not make current reductions
contract-conformant or ready for downstream scientific use.

This is not approval to replace PTC cleaning or to choose a new FRUIT policy.
No new scientific result is promised as a prerequisite to authoring these
conditional obligations.

## Proposed scientific content

| Topic | What the scientific core should establish | What it must not invent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Target and feedback model | Distinguish the intended sky quantity, a response-affected map, a selected projectable model and its support; require compatible units, geometry and response | A normalized MAP/JINC image is automatically an unbiased or deconvolved sky model |
| Transition and PTC interface | Exact remove/residual-process/bypass/rejoin roles and declared model/support operators; whole iteration and learned state have one owner | Another PCA algorithm; blanket residual-only learning; additive-map equivalence from a difference identity |
| Response and lost information | Conditional response composition under explicitly fixed operators and separate response of the full adaptive procedure; disclose missing/lost modes | Unit restored response, source-only adaptive differences, recoverability of every lost mode or complete uncertainty |
| Learning and restart | All state that can change future results is causal state; distinguish seed, restart, relearning and new generation | A checkpoint schema or a successful tested path proves completeness for every future method |
| Termination and products | Distinguish iteration completion, resource maximum, convergence, terminal selection and fitness for a named consumer | A universal stop threshold, default iteration count or scientific validity from reaching the maximum |
| Verification obligations | Predictive limiting cases with explicit assumptions, plus separate conformance and empirical-performance evidence | A toy pass or historical success qualifies an astronomical policy |

Examples of useful limiting cases are zero feedback under otherwise identical
state, an identity residual processor, declared support loss between removal
and restoration, and a perfect input model propagated through a non-identity
output response. Existing adequate derivations should be reused. These are
proposed topics for scientific reasoning, not new tests authorized to execute
or prescribed conclusions that override adjacent contracts.

Numerical parent admission, selection/sign policy, projection family,
adaptive detector rules, source/nuisance populations, thresholds, covariance
realizations and downstream-use criteria remain explicit owner questions.
Where an answer is required for an executable instance and unavailable, that
instance stays unavailable. Leaving a question open must not introduce a
silent default.

## Exact scope decision requested

Approve the scientific-core boundary in the table above and this narrow
revision of the
[September 1 sequence decision](SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_SEQUENCE_PRESERVATION_AND_PACKET_DIRECTION_2026-09-01.md):

1. A conditional scientific-core contract may proceed to separately approved
   authorship without a qualified numerical replacement. Its core may define
   obligations and conditional properties, but admits no numerical profile.
2. The accepted development, qualification and independent-pointing evidence
   requirements remain intact for numerical replacement/performance claims.
   No accepted result, numerical science or production authority is altered.
3. Before any author dispatch, prepare and obtain approval of one exact
   successor Stage A author packet: implementation-free scope, resolved core
   decisions, prior-authority reuse map and content-bound permitted references.
   A separate launch decision remains required.

The previously accepted sequence remains governing until the owner approves
this exception. The owner's conditional return to basics authorizes preparation
and consideration; it does not silently resolve this exact scientific-core
boundary or dispatch an author. No implementation, new reduction, numerical
scoring or policy search is included in the proposed decision.

The successor packet must not merely repackage the already accepted research
governance as new scientific work. It must identify each unresolved scientific
choice needed for the core and separate that from choices needed only for a
numerical profile. If the proposed core cannot be scientifically coherent
without selecting a numerical method, return that exact dependency to the
owner instead of starting a new empirical search or filling the gap by taste.

The alternative is to retain the qualification-first route and park this
package until a separately justified development program is ready. Neither
choice creates a production fallback. The recommendation is the bounded
scientific-core packet, with honest limits on its numerical availability.

## Completion and stop rule

One successor Stage A packet and one owner scope/sequence review complete this
next preparation step. No automatic chain of experimental proposals follows.
Any later request for numerical method development must name the missing
scientific decision and the evidence an experiment can add.

All original empirical records, EL-F14 proposal bytes, production behavior and
reduction products remain preserved. This scope candidate is bound by the
[review manifest](BOUNDED_REVIEW_MANIFEST_R0.1.md). Stage B still requires an
approved exact packet and separate launch decision; its author remains
implementation-blind.
